About

Security operations, built as software.

I am a Cyber Security student at The Islamia University of Bahawalpur. My work sits where security operations meet software: autonomous agents that triage SIEM alerts and enrich indicators of compromise, authentication systems hardened with JWT, bcrypt and audit logs, and attendance systems that resist spoofing.

In a full-time internship at CAIPSD I delivered six projects in two months, from RBAC authentication to a multi-agent AI SOC. I solved all 37 flags in a Capture The Flag competition, I design interfaces in Figma, and I coach an esports team.

Projects

Featured · Submitted to AMD Developer Hackathon ACT III (lablab.ai)

SentinelMesh / AegisSOC

An autonomous multi-agent Security Operations Center. Four cooperating agents take an alert from raw SIEM noise to a containment playbook.

  1. AgentTriageFilters anomalous entries from SIEM logs.
  2. AgentThreat IntelEnriches IOCs through VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB.
  3. AgentGraph AnalysisMaps the attack blast radius in Neo4j.
  4. AgentRemediationWrites context-aware containment playbooks.

Pipeline walkthrough ›Triage, Threat Intel, Graph Analysis, Remediation

  • A simulated attack telemetry feed drives the pipeline end to end.
  • A real-time WebSocket incident dashboard shows each incident as it moves through the agents.

Web app · Event operations

CAIPSD Event Ticket Portal

A single organizer portal for issuing event tickets. There is no public registration: organizers sign in, enter a participant's name, phone and email, and the system saves a unique QR ticket and emails it automatically.

Tickets stay valid for 3 days with unlimited re-entry. The server is hardened with a strict content security policy, login rate limiting, bcrypt password hashing and an SQLite-backed session store, and the API is covered by automated tests.

  • Node.js
  • Express
  • SQLite
  • Nodemailer
  • QR codes
  • html5-qrcode
  • Google Apps Script
  • Helmet
  • bcrypt
View on GitHub ↗
  1. 1
    Issue

    The organizer enters name, phone and email. A unique 16-character QR ticket is generated and saved.

  2. 2
    Email

    The ticket is sent automatically with its QR code, through Gmail or SMTP, with a Google Apps Script fallback.

  3. 3
    Scan

    At the gate the camera scanner reads the QR code and every entry is logged.

Biometrics

FaceAttend

AI eye-liveness attendance system. Face detection and descriptor matching run fully in the browser, and an Eye Aspect Ratio blink state machine blocks proxy attendance from photos or screen replay. Data stays local, syncs to Google Sheets, or exports to CSV.

  • JavaScript
  • face-api.js
  • TensorFlow.js
  • HTML5 Canvas
  • Google Sheets API

Voice-first interview simulator with dynamic follow-up questions. It scores answer quality (STAR structure), speaking confidence (words per minute, filler words) and English fluency, with progress charts and 7-day practice drills.
